item.title: ICG: "It's hard to imagine" Tripoli would risk its ties with Russia by approving a Ukrainian attack
item.description: Angela Diffley is pleased to welcome Claudia Gazzini, International Crisis Group's Senior Analyst for Libya. The Ukrainian attack on a Russian warship off the coast of eastern Libya has raised questions about Russian and Ukrainian military activity in the country. Gazzini discusses Russia's established military presence in eastern Libya and allegations that Ukrainian forces are operating in the west. item.title: Jensen Huang’s return has calmed markets but fears of an AI bubble still run deep
item.description: Nvidia's decision to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO pushed the AI computing company's stocks up more than 30 percent Monday. But the model of circular financing increasingly underwriting the AI boom still has some analysts worried that the party can't last forever.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Collapse of COP31: 'This deal was a bad deal and better no deal than a bad deal'
item.description: François Picard is joined by Ireland's former Environment Minister Eamon Ryan following the collapse of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey. “Political science trumps climate science still,” Ryan said the talks failed after the European Union and up to 100 countries refused to accept a final text that abandoned earlier commitments to transition away from fossil fuels.
item.dc:creator: François PICARD

item.title: 2025 AFCON: CAS set to hand down ruling on controversial final
item.description: The Court of Arbitration for Sport is today delivering its ruling on the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final. Senegal had won the match on the pitch, but Morocco were awarded the victory following an appeal.
item.dc:creator: L'Equipe TV

item.title: Live: Russian strikes on Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia kill two people and wound dozens more
item.description: A Russian attack killed two people in the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia overnight, regional governor Mykhailo Semikin said on Tuesday. Some 40 people, four of them children, were also wounded in the strikes, the governor added. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24
